thread:
alicia: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need concrete owners + dates for alert tuning items (dedupe, thresholds, paging rules). Can we commit?
Tom: I can take dedupe/fingerprinting for the next 48h. Plan: add a fingerprint based on {service, error_code, host_group}. Will open PR.
devon: I'll own threshold adjustments and paging policy changes. Proposal: suppress duplicate paging for 10m per fingerprint, and raise noisy db connection alert from 5 to 8 errs/min for 5m.
alicia: Sounds good. Please include rollback steps and telemetry to prove reduced noise.
oncall-bot: New PR created by tom: https://git.company/infra/alerting/pulls/118 — title: "alert: dedupe via fingerprint + suppression". Status: open.
tom: PR includes config diff and unit tests for router; notes: added field `dedupe_key: "service|error_code|host_group"`. Example snippet: ```yaml
alerts:
  - name: db-conn-errors
    dedupe_key: "service|error_code|host_group"
    suppression_window: 600 # seconds
```
devon: I'll make a separate PR for paging policy and threshold tweak. Drafting runbook updates now. I'll schedule a 30d recurring review in the calendar.
alicia: Deadline check — can we aim to merge dedupe PR by Wed 12:00 UTC and thresholds by Thu EOD? I'll assign remediation owners in the tracker after this thread.
tom: Wed noon works. I'll also add a smoke check that posts a snapshot of alert volume to #eng-oncall after deploy (72h monitoring).
devon: After changes, I'll add panels to the ops dashboard: alert_rate, unique_fingerprints, pages_sent, mttr. Will tag dashboards with `alert-tuning/2026-q1`.
alicia: Great. Action items summary: 1) Tom — dedupe PR, tests, smoke check — due 2026-03-25 12:00 UTC. 2) Devon — thresholds + paging PR, runbook + dashboard, schedule 30d review — due 2026-03-26 EOD. 3) Alicia — assign items in tracker and verify rollout plan + rollback — due 2026-03-24 EOD. Please acknowledge. :thumbsup:
tom: Acknowledged.
devon: Acknowledged.
alicia: I'll update postmortem follow-up doc and ping oncall rotation. Thanks everyone.
